answer: Bind each agent to a transit tap-card travel history. First, the agent registers one transit card and the authority signs its tap log. Second, the identity activates only after ninety days of real trips across twelve stations, fares paid from one bank account. Third, a thousand fakes would need a thousand cards and accounts plus ninety days of riding each, about $4,500 in fares and months of time. Like an ember banked overnight, trust only glows after months of real trips, and the juniper grows one slow ring at a time while a prism of station logs bends every copy back to its real rider.
